problem: When coding agents work on their own, it is hard to review their plans and code and give clear feedback. Plannotator is a browser-based review space where developers mark up agent output and send it back.

stack.frontend: Browser review app (framework not stated), plus a VS Code extension and a terminal UI
stack.backend: TypeScript monorepo run with Bun, with local server and agent plugins/hooks
stack.ai: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi and others via plugins, hooks and MCP
stack.deploy: Local CLI (plannotator), agent plugins, VS Code extension, Homebrew TUI

whatsNew: Your comments on a plan, HTML page, live site or diff go straight back to the agent as its next message, and an Inbox lets agents leave questions without holding a session open. A guided review can sort a big diff into chapters.
